title: Ask git what is going on
concept: Reading git status line by line

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: Git is watching, but it doesn't automatically save your work.

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: Use `git status` to see what git sees right now.

items.text: Find out which file is untracked

questions.prompt: Which file does git list as untracked?
questions.explanation: git status shows notes.txt in red under 'Untracked files'.

hints: Which command shows the current state of your files?
Run `git status` and read the output carefully.
Type `git status` and read the list of untracked files.
recap: `git status` tells you exactly what git sees. Run it often!

cheatSheet.summary: See the state of your files
